name: agent-model-router
title_zh: 多模型并行时替你分诊路由的调度员
tagline_zh: 同时跑多个专家模型不再手忙脚乱：它按任务维度自动分配 provider 和模型，还能并行启动、分别评估。
tagline_en: Run several expert models at once without chaos: it splits tasks by dimension, assigns providers/models, and.
desc_en: 列出 provider、选择模型、启动多个 agent 时必须使用。触发词：列出 provider、有哪些模型、选择模型、启动多个 agent、并行、多个专家、多维度、分别评估。
why_zh: 不是简单列模型列表，而是理解你“多维度分别评估”的意图，主动拆解任务并路由到合适模型。
why_en: It reads your intent for multi-dimensional assessment, not just lists models—it decomposes tasks and routes them to the right.
limit_zh: 需要你已配置好多个 provider 的 API 密钥；只负责路由和并行启动，不处理模型输出后的合并或对比分析。
limit_en: Requires API keys for multiple providers. Only routes and launches; no post-processing of outputs. Won't engage if you use a single model.
title_en: Router that dispatches tasks across multiple AI models
